title.narrative: Strengthening the NDA and Key Stakeholders in Angola on GCF Mechanisms

description.narrative: Active

This Readiness project aims to enhance the institutional, human, and technical capacity of Angola’s National Designated Authority (NDA), housed within the Ministry of Environment (MINAMB), to effectively engage with the Green Climate Fund (GCF). It focuses on establishing the mechanisms, frameworks, and coordination systems needed to enable the NDA to perform its roles, including programming, oversight, stakeholder engagement, project screening, and facilitating access to climate finance.

To strengthen the NDA’s capacity and strategic framework to engage effectively with the GCF, enabling Angola to access and utilize climate finance to implement its climate priorities under the NDC and national development strategies.
